name: Caboom of Chaos
description: A retro-inspired top-down arcade bomber set in the Northern Flights universe. Choose your character, outwit AI opponents, and turn the arena upside down with bombs, power-ups, and throwable Chaos Discs.
platform: HTML5 browser build available here. Android testing build; iOS export planned. No public mobile app-store release verified.
features: Bomb upgrades and throwable Chaos Discs
Local high scores and campaign trophies
Touch controls for Android and iOS layouts
note: The browser build has a large initial download. Saves and high scores stay in this browser’s site storage; clearing site data can erase progress. A click or tap may be needed to start audio.

name: Chains of Chaos
tagline: Take the adventure beyond the fairway.
description: Throw discs, battle enemies, explore levels, and uncover the story behind Chains of Chaos. Meet Northern Flights characters in an original disc golf platform adventure.
platform: Browser demo available here on Northern Flights Gaming. Android listing linked by the official Northern Flights site; iOS development announced, with no release date confirmed.
note: Progress saved in the old nonprofit-site browser demo does not automatically transfer to this gaming domain. The original game URL remains available for existing players.

name: Carts of Chaos
tagline: The chaos hits the starting grid.
description: An arcade kart-racing project with Northern Flights characters. Get a first look at the game's original title artwork while development continues.
platform: In development. Public downloads and supported release platforms have not been verified.

name: DiscMon
tagline: One more pellet. One more high score.
description: Navigate the maze, collect pellets, grab power-ups, and take on the ghosts in a retro arcade game with a Northern Flights disc golf theme.
platform: The current browser version remains on the original Northern Flights website, using its existing Ubuntu-backed score service.
note: This version stays on its existing website for score-service compatibility. New local-only game builds are separate; their score behavior may differ.

name: Cribbage of Chaos
tagline: Classic cards. A little Northern chaos.
description: Classic cribbage with a Northern Flights twist. The published browser game lets you play against the computer and test your cribbage skills. A separate local project includes multiplayer screens; a public multiplayer service has not been verified.
platform: Browser game available here on Northern Flights Gaming. Public multiplayer service availability remains unverified.
features: Computer opponent in the published version
note: Browser storage is separate from the old nonprofit website. Existing saved data does not automatically transfer between domains.
